_schema.description: BLDC motor catalog for use with COMPAct-style actuator decomposition. Each entry is a single motor — gearboxes are added at runtime to form an Actuator. Add custom motors by appending to the `motors` array.

motors.name: M-mini
motors.notes: Small flat BLDC; representative of Antigravity 4006 / iPower class.

motors.name: M-mid
motors.notes: Mid-size flat BLDC; representative of T-Motor U8 / GBM5208 class.

motors.name: M-big
motors.notes: Large flat BLDC; representative of T-Motor U10-II class.

motors.name: TMotor-U8-Lite
motors.notes: T-Motor U8 Lite KV150; popular in MIT-Cheetah-class quadrupeds.

motors.name: TMotor-U10II
motors.notes: T-Motor U10-II KV100; high-torque pancake for >20 kg robots.

motors.name: Maxon-EC-i-52
motors.notes: Maxon EC-i 52 brushless servo; high-cycle industrial unit.
